description: Return totals for every domain in the public SecLens.ONE corpus, plus a list of those domains with their latest score, newest first. "stats" holds the domain count, average score, score bands and per-protocol present and effective counts. "results" holds one row per domain (Domain, Score, Generated, Profile, IsMailEnabled, HasNullMX, NullMXCompliant). Use this for overall adoption figures, not for one domain's details (use get_result instead). By default, results lists the 50 newest domains and is about 8 KB. The maximum limit is 500. Stats always cover the full corpus. Set stats_only to true for stats and an empty results list.

limit.description: Newest rows to return. Defaults to 50. Maximum 500. Stats always cover the full corpus.

stats_only.description: When true, results is an empty list. Stats still cover the full corpus.

name: get_summary
title: Get Public Corpus Summary
